name: padina
description: Claude Code plugins by Roy Padina.

plugins.name: cmux-control
plugins.description: Wires Claude Code into the cmux terminal — sidebar notifications that say what finished and where, progress pills, a session inventory, and a skill that knows the cmux CLI.

plugins.name: agentctl-sessions
plugins.description: Name, label, flag, annotate, schedule and close out Claude Code sessions — Claude does it for you, and agentctl shows it in its session picker.

plugins.name: heeng-keyboard-translator
plugins.description: Repairs text typed with the wrong keyboard layout (Hebrew ↔ English) — per word, so a half-garbled sentence is fixed too.

plugins.name: espanso-control
plugins.description: Teaches Claude the Espanso text-expansion CLI — config paths, match YAML patterns, package management — plus a /espanso-doctor preflight for PATH, version, daemon status, service registration and config path.

plugins.name: recipe-research
plugins.description: Researches a dish with three parallel subagents — classic recipes, food science, pro-chef technique — and synthesizes a restaurant-level recipe into a linked note tree. Obsidian optional.

plugins.name: session-management
plugins.description: Mid-session recap, a resume-all check after sleep/network/account disruptions, and an end-of-session close-out that closes the session on "close" — so nothing a Claude Code session started falls through the cracks.

plugins.name: finalize-app-release
plugins.description: End-of-dev release checklist for roypadina's Mac apps — version, CHANGELOG, README, wiki, Ko-fi, GitHub release, Homebrew tap and the local install, checked by a script and fixed by Claude.

plugins.name: maccyplus-clipboard
plugins.description: Lets Claude leave SQL queries and commands in your MaccyPlus clipboard history, labelled with the session that produced them and a note on where to run them, and manage history items.

plugins.name: agents-session-hopper
plugins.description: Teaches Claude to steer AgentsSessionHopper: which of your Claude accounts this session runs on, usage left, switch or hold, and how to pick work back up after a move.

plugins.name: obsidian-vault-manager
plugins.description: Keeps any Obsidian vault's structure under control: a Vault Structure note with rules and a writers registry, a regenerable index, safe restructuring, and reference updates in everything that points into the vault.

plugins.name: mac-design
plugins.description: Design, build and review native macOS app interfaces (SwiftUI + AppKit) to Apple quality — Liquid Glass, windows, toolbars, menus, Settings, menu-bar apps, permission flows, accessibility and app icons, with an audit mode that ranks fixes.

plugins.name: ghostex-control
plugins.description: Drive the Ghostex agent workspace from Claude Code — find your own session, start terminal and agent sessions, type into them, read and wait on their output, and close only what you created, with the CLI traps written down.
